overview: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn shared announcements regarding local grant awards, public surveys, bike infrastructure projects, and the start of the school year.

items.title: Clippership Connector Groundbreaking
items.summary: Mayor Breanna Lungo-Koehn announced a September groundbreaking ceremony in partnership with DCR for the Clippership Connector bike path extension.

items.title: Charter Study Committee Survey
items.summary: The Mayor encouraged residents to complete the newly opened Charter Study Committee survey to assist in updating the city charter.

items.title: Senior Center Digital Literacy Grant
items.summary: Senior Center Director Pam Kelly secured a $45,000 digital literacy grant to support technology access for seniors.

items.title: Urban Forestry Grant
items.summary: The city received an urban forestry grant of over $100,000 to bolster the resiliency of Medford's urban forest network.

items.title: Community Connection Transportation Grants
items.summary: Traffic and Transportation Director Todd Blake secured two grants totaling nearly $180,000 to expand bike parking and Bluebike stations.

items.title: Back to School Announcement
items.summary: Mayor Lungo-Koehn wished students, families, and school staff good luck for the upcoming school year.
